reproduction.contract: Requires all three exact payload hashes before parsing; emits separate per-handle diagnostics, raw record references and conversion outcomes. Uses bounded nonblocking regular-file admission; output always sets qualification_eligible=false. A changed payload was refused before parsing.

limits: No independent producer-native measurements, separate geometry kernel, before-repair validity, external placement, complete active-reference/history interpretation, successful REGION conversion, rendering or native FreeCAD qualification. The earlier source also has three object parse failures and an orphan DataStorage record. Do not promote any P7 support claim from these observations.
